source.scope: Source-defined vectors and related surveillance taxa; inclusion does not establish disease transmission.
source.matching: Exact scientific binomial-name matching; named subspecies roll up to species. Genus, group, complex and uncertain labels excluded. Synonyms are not inferred.
source.inventory: Current GenBank chromosome-scale and complete eukaryotic assemblies
source.type_grouping: Taxonomic groupings of the source species inventory; group membership does not imply vector competence.
